name: Weather
summary: Forecasts, past weather, air quality and marine conditions.
description: A community MCP server for the free Open-Meteo APIs: place search, 16-day forecasts, weather since 1940, air quality and pollen, marine, flood, seasonal and climate data. No key or account; the free tier is for non-commercial use.
access: Sends place names and coordinates to open-meteo.com
Free public weather API; non-commercial use with rate limits. Paid weather keys/subscriptions are unsupported by this connector; the chat model's plan does not change weather access.
No account-status detection. A subscription cannot be inferred from a model plan or a saved key.
